title: Playing only for himself and the scrapbook as fulfilled dream
summary: Guesnon says he is his own harsh critic and that everything he did was for himself.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant
